items.subject: Petition under Sections 79(1)(c) and 79(1)(k) of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with Regulation 19(3) of the CERC (Indian Electricity Grid Code) (First Amendment) Regulations, 2024 (seeking extension of time for infirm power injection); and Regulation 57 of the CERC (Indian Electricity Grid Code) Regulations, 2023 read with Regulation 65 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 2023, seeking relaxation/extension of the time prescribed for filing the present petition. Petition under Sections 79(1)(c) and 79(1)(k) of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with Regulation 19(3) of the CERC (Indian Electricity Grid Code) (First Amendment) Regulations, 2024 (seeking extension of time for infirm power injection); and Regulation 57 of the CERC (Indian Electricity Grid Code) Regulations, 2023 read with Regulation 65 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 2023, seeking relaxation/extension of the time prescribed for filing the present petition.

**Parties Present:** Shri Aman Anand, Advocate, JSWREL Shri Aman Dixit, Advocate, JSWREL

The present Petition has been filed by the JSW Renew Energy Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as the “Petitioner”) seeking extension of time for injection of infirm power under Regulation 19(3) of the CERC (Indian Electricity Grid Code) Regulations, 2023, for conducting PPC testing and commissioning in respect of 10 Wind Turbine Generators (WTGs) (27 MW) forming part of its 270 MW wind power project and relaxation of the time prescribed for filing the present petition. The Petitioner has made the following prayers:

- _(a) Grant extension of time for injection of infirm power in respect of the balance 10 WTG Nos. LOT-5 Req Id (DPM-064, DPM-065, DPM-066, DPM-067, DPM068, DPM-069, DPM-070, DPM-072, DPM-073, DPM-074) for conducting PPC (Power Plant Controller) Testing of the Petitioner's wind power project; and permit 30 days to the petitioner to commission the said WTGs;_

- (g) In terms of proviso (b) of Regulation 19(3) of the Grid Code, the present Petition should have been filed 15 days prior to expiry of the earlier approved period of infirm injection, i.e. on 15.01.2026. The present Petition is being filed on 24.03.2026 after a delay of 67 days, and the Petitioner therefore seeks condonation of the delay in filing the instant petition under the Commission's power to relax.

- (h) The delay in completion of energisation activities for the balance WTGs has occurred due to uncontrollable factors, which were entirely beyond the control of the Petitioner. The Petitioner has successfully commissioned the majority of the Project capacity, remobilised resources at the site, and is fully ready to energise the remaining WTGs and complete all pre-commissioning and commissioning activities within the extended period sought, i.e., 30 days.

**3.** The extracts of the Record of Proceedings for the hearing dated 22.04.2026 are as under:

_3.  Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel and the representative for the parties, the Commission directed as under:_

- _(a)  The Petitioner to implead SECI as party to the Petition and to file revised memo of parties within two days._

- _(c)  The Respondents, including SECI were directed to file their respective replies within two weeks with an advance copy to the Petitioner who may file its rejoinder, if any, within a week thereafter_

- _(d)  The Petitioner to file the following information, on an affidavit, within a week:_

## **Submissions of the Petitioner in Compliance to the RoP for hearing dated 22.04.2026:**

**4.** The Petitioner has impleaded SECI as a party to the present Petition and furnished the COD certificate of 162 MW capacity. Petitioner has also submitted that the PPC

**5.** The learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that the Petitioner has complied with the directions issued vide the Record of Proceedings dated 22.4.2026 and furnished the additional information sought therein, and none of the Respondents has filed any reply. Considering the submissions made by the Petitioner, the Commission reserved the matter for orders.

**7.** The Petitioner is seeking an extension of time to inject infirm power for a period of 30 days. Further, the Petitioner has submitted that in terms of proviso (b) of Regulation 19(3) of the Grid Code, the present Petition should have been filed 15 days prior to expiry of the earlier approved period of infirm injection, i.e. on 15.01.2026. The present Petition was, however, filed on 24.03.2026, with a delay of 67 days; therefore, the Petitioner seeks condonation of the delay in filing the instant petition.

**8.** We have considered the submissions of Petitioner and documents placed on the record.

## **Issue 1:  Whether the delay in filing the instant Petition can be condoned? Whether the Petitioner can be granted an extension of time for the injection of infirm power for testing and commissioning of 10 WTGs (10*2.7 MW)?**

**13.** We also observe that in response to the Petitioner’s letter dated 13.03.2026, SRLDC

**14.** The Petitioner has prayed for the condonation of the delay in filing the instant Petition, invoking the Commission's power to relax under Regulation 57 of the Grid Code. We note that the Petitioner should have approached RLDC 10 days prior to 1.11.2025, as per the Grid Code, seeking an extension of the period if it was envisaged that it would not be able to achieve COD by the stipulated period. PPC testing failed on 27.9.2025, well before 21.10.2025, when the Petitioner should have approached the RLDC. However, Petitioner approached RLDC as late as March 2026. We are of the considered view that the Petitioner, once having obtained FTC from RLDC, should have informed RLDC about its inability to complete the commissioning within the stipulated period. Petitioner is directed to keep RLDC informed of any such event and the tentative time by which it expects to resolve the issue.

**15.** Keeping in view that the Petitioner is in the advanced stage of commissioning of its project, we condone the delay in filing the instant Petition. Further, we permit the Petitioner an extension of the period for injection of infirm power for a period of 30 days from the date of issuance of this Order under Regulation 19(3) of the Grid Code. The events impacting commissioning activities are acknowledged only to allow extension of the infirm of power under the Grid Code, and not otherwise.
